title: tk config migrate: convert config.md structured sections to runners.toml
description:
The migration path other repos need — without it this epic is a breaking change dressed as a cleanup.

tk config migrate reads .tick/config.md, extracts the four structured sections (Testing commands, Closeout Evidence Commands, Acceptance Evidence, Pi Orchestrator), writes them into .tick/runners.toml under the tables from tick 728, and REWRITES config.md to keep only what belongs there: Rules, and the narrative testing hints. Preserve every existing runners.toml key and comment — this is an edit, not a regeneration.

Idempotent: re-running changes nothing. Default to a dry run printing the diff, with an explicit flag to write, mirroring the fail-closed posture of the planning apply path. Refuse and explain rather than guessing when a section does not parse cleanly, and never silently drop a line: anything it cannot classify must be reported, not discarded.
acceptance_criteria: Running it on a copy of this repo config.md produces a runners.toml that validates against the schema and a config.md containing only prose; re-running is a no-op; an unparseable section causes a refusal naming the line rather than a partial write; the dry run is the default and writes nothing.
